additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480758-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2 / S1 313508370023] Log Check CRM:03431000112
additional_info.body:
Dear Alba,
Regarding the reported issue, we reviewed the logs and identified a problem with the output contactors QA21-QA22 during the customer's charging session. This contactor behavior may result from various causes, including factors on the vehicle side, but it is not related to a malfunction of the main fan GQ1.
We will continue to monitor the charger to see if the issue recurs and plan to inspect or replace the main fan during the next on-site maintenance visit. For now, I am closing the ticket.
If you receive another report from the customer, please open a new ticket, and we will arrange an intervention to investigate the situation further.
Thank you for your attention.
Best regards,
CANCELLIERI, Giuseppe (SI E EU IT)
